svg.aria-label: A Gamut study file laid open: each run one table row with its inputs, status, split, results and the spread of its lift over transition criteria, continued by its pressure coefficient at every node of the shared mesh, with a query shading the runs it picks.
svg.text: One shared mesh. Each run is a row: inputs, status, split, results and a spread stored beside lift, then its field at every node.
no values: the run did not converge
cl_std: sample standard deviation of cl over transition criteria Ncrit 7, 9 and 11 (cl is Ncrit 9); a sensitivity, not a confidence interval.
split: a seeded draw of about a fifth of the runs, for testing within this sweep. Dotted gaps stand for rows not drawn.
363 runs × 160 nodes in one file, read and written from Python, MATLAB, Julia, C++ and C.
